messages:
ella: Quick heads-up — planning to enable halcyon-8k-q2 in the catalog during a stepped rollout tomorrow 13:00-15:00 UTC. Using a thermostat-style safety gate: we ramp based on telemetry, not just time.

Plan:
- prewarm prefix cache in eu/us (30m before)
- staged ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% (checks at each step)
- autoscale boosters live during window
- fallback ordering: fallback to halcyon-8k-q1 (float variant) then to sentinel-7b for short queries

Rollback triggers: P95 latency +150ms vs baseline for >=10m OR error-rate +5% sustained for 5m. If either fires we auto-degen back to q1.

Addendum: we'll pin legacy-compat variant for first 6h to prevent older client surprises. @ops-sarah can you vet the SLO checks?

raj: Sounds good. For pinning, do we do a soft-pin (route still allowed to change) or hard pin? I think soft-pin first 6h then release.

mike: Are we excluding ap-south for the initial ramp? last time the warmup took longer there.

devex-joel: I'll draft the release note and quickstart snippet. Placeholder: "halcyon-8k-q2: +20% perf on long-context, recommend as default for streaming workloads". Will post before EOD.

deploy-bot: dry-run OK — simulated enable command:
```
$ catalogctl enable --model halcyon-8k-q2 --stages 1,5,25,100 --prewarm true --pin legacy-compat:6h --window 2h
Simulating routing changes... no conflicts found.
```

ops-sarah: LGTM on thresholds but add a circuit-breaker that forces a 0% hold for 2m if 3 sequential checks fail. Also add an alert to #incidents with the rollout ID.

ella: Good idea. We'll add: circuit-breaker -> short hold + paging if not recovered. Rollout ID: r-2026-331-halcyon.

raj: I'll do the soft-pin: command I use: `catalogctl pin --model halcyon-8k-q2 --variant legacy-compat --type soft --duration 6h`

mike: For prewarm, recommend this snippet to warm KV cache: `prefetch --model halcyon-8k-q2 --prefixes /warmup/eng/ --concurrency 8` — runs 30m before.

ella: Updated thresholds in ops doc: P95 baseline = 240ms, so rollback at 390ms. Error baseline = 0.8%, rollback at 5.8%. Will add to runbook.

deploy-bot: scheduling enable job: r-2026-331-halcyon at 2026-03-22T13:00:00Z. Prewarm start at 2026-03-22T12:30:00Z.

devex-joel: Release note draft below — feel free to edit:
"halcyon-8k-q2 now in catalog: opt-in staged rollout. Expect better long-context stability and lower token cost on dense prompts. Note: legacy-compat soft-pinned for 6h to ease migration. For rollback, platform will auto-hold on latency or error budget regressions. See docs/redwood/halcyon-8k-q2.md for details"

mike: One last ops ask — ensure fallback ordering is explicit in runtime config. If q1 is busy, prefer sentinel-7b for <=128 tokens only. Otherwise q1.

ella: Will add those constraints. Also toggling KV-cache ttl to 12h for the first day to reduce cold misses.

deploy-bot: canary step 1 (1%) started: 1746012400 — metric hooks attached.

ella: Team, please ack here when you’ve updated your trackers and ownership. I'll watch the first two steps and call the green if metrics stay within guardrails. :thumbsup:

raj: acked — pin applied (soft).

ops-sarah: acked — alerts wired to #incidents and on-call page.

mike: acked — prewarm scheduled and KV-ttl set.

devex-joel: acked — release note posted and docs link added to PR.

deploy-bot: canary step 2 (5%) completed at 1746012540 — telemetry stable.

ella: great. moving to 25% in 10m unless anything unexpected shows up.

(reacts: :rocket: :eyes: )
